AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

2. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards

   A. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
